rows.commentary: 0.1: No run for Balbirnie off Ruben Trumpelmann.
0.2: Balbirnie does not score off Ruben Trumpelmann.
0.3: No run for Balbirnie off Ruben Trumpelmann.
0.4: A single to Balbirnie off Ruben Trumpelmann.
0.5: Dot ball from Ruben Trumpelmann to Paul Stirling.
0.6: Paul Stirling does not score off Ruben Trumpelmann.
1.1: Smit probes with an away-swinger that stays low, creeping beneath Balbirnie's attempted cut and through to the gloves.
1.2: Smit gifts width outside off, allowing Andrew Balbirnie to slash hard and dispatch it scorching through cover-point for four.
1.3: Smit attacks the stumps on a good length, met solidly by Balbirnie off the front foot.
1.4: Balbirnie flashes hard at a length ball across him, a thick edge flying straight into the hands of the lone slip fielder who leaps and bursts through before it races to third man.
1.5: Smit extracts away-swing from a probing delivery, safely patted down into the off-side.
1.6: Smit finishes the over with a tight delivery, firmly blocked away toward the off-side.
2.1: Ruben Trumpelmann drifts far down the leg-side with a shooter that barely leaves the turf, earning an immediate wide.
2.1: Ruben Trumpelmann drops on a good length at middle stump, expertly dead-batting by Paul Stirling toward mid-on.
2.2: Ruben Trumpelmann digs it in short at the hips, catching Stirling's thick inside edge off the pull to deflect off his body into the on-side.
2.3: Ruben Trumpelmann strays slightly, allowing Paul Stirling to nudge a single down toward backward square leg.
2.4: A leg bye off Ruben Trumpelmann's delivery to Balbirnie.
15.1: Ruben Trumpelmann arches his back and tests the width, offering Cade Carmichael a short delivery that gets sliced away to deep point for a brisk single.
15.2: Ruben Trumpelmann fires it in, and Paul Stirling stays back to tuck it neatly into the on-side for a comfortable run.
15.3: Ruben Trumpelmann hits a good length around off-stump, met by the unwavering front-foot defence of Cade Carmichael.
15.4: Ruben Trumpelmann pitches it fuller on middle and leg, allowing Cade Carmichael to tickle it off his pads and scamper back for a couple of runs.
15.5: Ruben Trumpelmann angles one in at off-stump, catching the thick inside edge of Cade Carmichael's back-foot prod as it trickles down to fine leg.
15.6: Ruben Trumpelmann stares in utter disbelief as a snorter keeps alarmingly low, ducking clean under Paul Stirling's bat and flashing past the off-stump into the keeper's gloves.
16.1: Bernard Scholtz extracts more vicious low bounce from the surface, forcing Cade Carmichael to crouch and dab it out toward backward point.
16.2: Bernard Scholtz delivers as Cade Carmichael shuffles across the crease, punches cleanly to mid-on, and beats the throw with a sharp call for a single.
16.3: Bernard Scholtz watches as Paul Stirling drills it straight back at him, the bowler halting sharply in his followthrough to gather.
16.4: Bernard Scholtz loops up a teasing flight on off-stump, safely smothered toward cover by Paul Stirling.

16.5: Bernard Scholtz is launched downtown as Paul Stirling skips down the track, the long-on fielder's valiant full-length dive carrying him and the ball across the ropes to bring up a magnificent fifty for the Ireland skipper.
16.6: Bernard Scholtz darts it in as Paul Stirling clears a path by making room, dead-batting the ball into the off-side toward backward point.
17.1: Jack Brassell starts the over on a good length outside off, clipped firmly toward the off-side by Cade Carmichael for no run.
17.2: Jack Brassell fires it very full into middle and leg, leaving Cade Carmichael to hurriedly jam it away on the off-side.
17.3: Jack Brassell drops it short and wide, allowing Cade Carmichael to angle the face behind point for a brisk couple after a sharp sprint from the deep fielder.
17.4: Jack Brassell persists with the short and wide line, beating Cade Carmichael all ends up as the bat swishes through empty air.
17.5: Jack Brassell sneaks one low past the leg stump, catching Cade Carmichael completely off guard as a premeditated pull shot is thwarted by the lack of bounce.
17.6: Jack Brassell finishes the over with a straight delivery, met solidly in defense by Cade Carmichael straight back to the bowler's hands.
29.6: Waldo Smith delivers to Cade Carmichael, driven firmly to the right where a sharp reflex stop at cover denies the single.
30.1: Bernard Scholtz slides one into Harry Tector, who attempts a sweep and misses as the ball whisks past leg-stump.
30.2: Bernard Scholtz fires a flatter delivery on middle and leg, turned away off the back foot for a single by Harry Tector.
30.3: Bernard Scholtz bowls to Cade Carmichael, who shuffles across his stumps and nudges it to the right of short mid-wicket for one.
30.4: Bernard Scholtz hits the pitch to Harry Tector, who drives the delivery cleanly to cover-point for a dot.
30.5: Bernard Scholtz drops it fractionally short, allowing Harry Tector to pull it off the screws deep into the mid-wicket stands for a maximum.
30.6: Bernard Scholtz attacks from back of a length, safely repelled straight back down the pitch by Harry Tector.
31.1: Waldo Smith offers width outside off, allowing Cade Carmichael to ride the bounce and dab to backward point for a sharp single.
31.2: Waldo Smith targets the back foot, neatly tucked away by Harry Tector toward deep square leg to rotate the strike.
31.3: Waldo Smith serves up a half-volley outside off, drilled exquisitely through the covers by Cade Carmichael to race away for four.
31.4: Waldo Smith probes from a back-of-a-length spot, solidly blocked into the off-side by Cade Carmichael.
31.5: Waldo Smith lands a good length delivery outside off, calmly guided into the off-side by Cade Carmichael.
31.6: Waldo Smith drops it full outside off and Cade Carmichael uncorks a ferocious square drive through the infield to find the ropes.
32.1: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton floats one up, met sharply off the back foot by Harry Tector into the on-side.
32.2: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton lures Harry Tector into a drive that catches the edge, allowing Bernard Scholtz to tumble and clutch a sharp catch at backward point.
32.3: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton delivers a tight ball back-driven firmly by Lorcan Tucker to halt the bowler's followthrough.
32.4: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton draws a defensive push from Lorcan Tucker toward backward point for a single.
32.5: Dot ball from Loftie-Eaton to Cade Carmichael.
44.2: Ruben Trumpelmann drops a low full toss onto off-stump, allowing Curtis Campher room to toe-end a drive toward mid-off for a single.
44.3: Ruben Trumpelmann slips a slower delivery onto middle stump, completely stymying George Dockrell's attempt to put it away.
44.4: Ruben Trumpelmann rushes George Dockrell as the batsman dances down the track, missing the length and getting beaten outside off.
44.5: Ruben Trumpelmann bangs it back of a length on middle, catching George Dockrell's thick inside edge onto the pads to roll softly toward the off-side.
44.6: Ruben Trumpelmann gets George Dockrell lunging to cut, only for the batsman to chop it awkwardly toward backward point.
45.1: Loftie-Eaton is driven wide of cover as Curtis Campher collects a quick single.

45.2: Loftie-Eaton claims George Dockrell stumped as the batsman gives room to clear cover, is beaten by the turning ball, and watches Zane Green flash off the bails to end a scoreless seven-ball stay.
45.3: Loftie-Eaton watches Andy McBrine push one wide of the cover fielder to scamper through for a single.
45.4: Loftie-Eaton slides a flatter delivery onto the pads, tucked away to the on-side for a hurried brace.
45.5: Loftie-Eaton receives a dab down to third man as Curtis Campher skillfully opens the face of the bat.
45.6: Loftie-Eaton angles one across the left-hander, allowing Andy McBrine to dab it toward third man and retain the strike with a single.
46.1: Smit serves up a fuller length on middle, firmly driven down to long-on by Andy McBrine for a single.
46.2: Smit drops in a slower ball on off-stump, allowing Curtis Campher to steer it neatly toward point for a single.
46.3: JJ Smit goes to the slower delivery once more, keeping it dangerously low as it sneaks under Andy McBrine's bat straight into the keeper's gloves.
46.4: Smit angles this one into the pads, prompting Andy McBrine to shuffle across and clip it away cleanly toward square leg for a run.
46.5: Curtis Campher dances down the track looking to heave it over the on-side, but he swings entirely through thin air and misses by a street.
46.6: No run for Curtis Campher off Smit.
0.1: Jai Moondra starts from around off, angling one in to Michael van Lingen who taps it towards covers.
0.2: Jai Moondra feeds a fullish length on middle and off, flicked away to wide mid-on by Michael van Lingen to open his account.
0.3: Jai Moondra draws the inward swing on off, finding Louren Steenkamp leaning forward into a solid block.
0.4: Jai Moondra offers a fraction too much room on off, allowing Louren Steenkamp to lean forward and punch a crisp drive past mid-off with the full face of the bat all the way to the rope.
0.5: Jai Moondra curls it in full, and Louren Steenkamp clips it straight to mid-wicket.
0.6: Jai Moondra dangles one on a driveable length outside off, but Louren Steenkamp resists the temptation and leaves it alone.
1.1: Liam McCarthy offers width on a shortish delivery, crushed through the covers by Michael van Lingen as the chase kicks into gear before a fielder cuts it off near the boundary for three.
1.2: Liam McCarthy hits a hard length on off, defended comfortably towards covers by Louren Steenkamp.
1.3: Liam McCarthy drops it short of a length outside off, eliciting a mistimed punch towards extra cover from Louren Steenkamp.
1.4: Liam McCarthy induces a top-edge from a rising short ball that Jai Moondra spills at fine leg after misjudging the run, gifting two runs.
1.5: Liam McCarthy extracts extra bounce from a good length on off, rapping Louren Steenkamp high on the thigh pad as he plays defensively.
1.6: Liam McCarthy pins a short of length delivery onto off stump, safely blocked from the crease towards covers by Louren Steenkamp.
2.1: Jai Moondra targets a back-of-a-length region on off-stump, which Michael van Lingen defends with watchful care.
2.2: Jai Moondra fires it very full outside off, and Michael van Lingen digs the ball out toward the covers.
2.3: Jai Moondra angles a good length delivery down leg, catching Lingen's pads as he attempts a cross-bat shot, deflecting it behind.
2.4: Jai Moondra tests Lingen with a hard length on off, met by a back-foot punch driven straight to cover-point.
2.5: Jai Moondra hurries one through on a back of a length in the channel, inducing a thick inside edge off Lingen's attempted cover drive that races past the stumps toward fine leg for a single.
2.6: Jai Moondra pitches up on off-stump, allowing Louren Steenkamp to drive on the up directly to mid-on.

3.1: Liam McCarthy bowls to Michael van Lingen, who snatches the ball right behind the line and drives it crisply past the non‑striker, while the mid‑on fielder sprints to the fence and slides to save a run.
3.2: A bye off McCarthy's delivery to Steenkamp.
3.3: Liam McCarthy offers width with a pitched-up delivery outside off, and Michael van Lingen dispatches it smoothly to the boundary.
15.1: Andy McBrine bowls to Loftie-Eaton, who drives a full outside off into sweeper cover for a single.
15.2: Andy McBrine delivers a turning ball toward leg‑stump to Gerhard Erasmus, who tucks it round the corner for a run.
15.3: Andy McBrine sends a short outside‑off to Loftie‑Eaton, who swings it with spin toward sweeper cover.
15.4: Andy McBrine bowls a short outside‑off to Gerhard Erasmus, who punches it to cover‑point for a quick single.
15.5: Andy McBrine bowls a full‑on off delivery to Loftie‑Eaton, who plays it softly toward backward point.
15.6: Andy McBrine bowls a short outside‑off delivery to Loftie‑Eaton, who punches it past backward point for a single.
16.1: Gavin Hoey delivers a toss‑up outside off to Loftie‑Eaton, who nudges it toward backward point.
16.2: Gavin Hoey sends a back‑of‑a‑length ball to Loftie‑Eaton, who punches it square of the wicket for a single.
16.3: Gavin Hoey bowls a floaty full delivery drifting in on middle and leg to Gerhard Erasmus, who leans ahead in defence, leaving no run.
16.4: Gavin Hoey delivers a tossed-up ball just outside off to Gerhard Erasmus, who leans ahead to block and produces an inside‑edge onto his pads, stifling a close lbw appeal.
16.5: Gavin Hoey sends a floaty delivery outside off to Gerhard Erasmus, who kneels and slams a slog sweep through mid‑wicket for a four.
16.6: Gavin Hoey lofts a flighted ball around off to Gerhard Erasmus, who leans forward and guides it to covers for a dot.
17.1: Andy McBrine bowls a full outside off to Loftie‑Eaton, who blocks it off the front foot for no run.
17.2: McBrine delivers a full ball in line of the stumps to Loftie‑Eaton, who deflects it to short mid‑wicket for a dot.
17.3: McBrine tosses a delivery up to Loftie‑Eaton, who drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
17.4: McBrine bowls a quicker, full in line of the stumps to Gerhard Erasmus, who strokes it down to long‑on for a run.
17.5: McBrine sends a length‑around‑off ball from round the wicket to Loftie‑Eaton, who dabs it to backward point for a single.
17.6: McBrine flies a delivery on off to Gerhard Erasmus, who lunges in defence for a dot.

23.4: Liam McCarthy bowls a back‑of‑the‑length delivery to Ruben Trumpelmann, the ball skids off his pads into the leg side, yielding a single leg‑bye while the fielders scramble for a stifled lbw appeal.
23.5: Liam McCarthy fires in a yorker on the stumps, smartly dug out toward mid-on by Smit.
23.6: Liam McCarthy bangs it back of a length outside off, clipped expertly by Smit toward deep cover to keep the strike.
24.1: George Dockrell strikes as Smit flashes hard at a shorter delivery outside off, slicing an uncontrolled catch straight to Curtis Campher at backward point.
24.2: George Dockrell lands it on a length around middle, solidly pushed towards the covers by Waldo Smith.
24.3: George Dockrell tosses it full on off, met firmly on the front foot by Waldo Smith straight to extra cover.
24.4: George Dockrell darts an arm-ball into the pads, deflecting it to backward square leg as Waldo Smith aborts a risky single.
24.5: George Dockrell floats one up on off stump, allowing Waldo Smith to push it down to long-off and get off the mark.
24.6: George Dockrell drifts one down leg, tickled neatly past short fine by Ruben Trumpelmann for a quick single.
25.1: Liam McCarthy targets the leg stump from back of a length, turning Ruben Trumpelmann's inner-edge deflection toward square leg.
25.2: Liam McCarthy spears a low skiddy delivery into the leg side, and Waldo Smith scampers back for a hard-earned second run.
25.3: Liam McCarthy unleashes a sharp bouncer outside the off stump, and Waldo Smith watches it sail safely through to the keeper.
25.4: Liam McCarthy pitches it full outside off, inviting Waldo Smith to drive crisply on the up to mid-off.
25.5: Liam McCarthy bowls a shortish delivery on off, and Waldo Smith rises on his toes to dead-bat it toward the covers.
25.6: Liam McCarthy angles a full one into the pads, allowing Waldo Smith to flick through mid-wicket and hustle back for an easy second run.
26.1: George Dockrell serves it full on off, prompting Ruben Trumpelmann to lean forward and block off the inner half just to the right of the bowler.
26.2: George Dockrell fires in a back-of-a-length slider on off, cleanly punched straight back to the bowler by Ruben Trumpelmann.
26.3: George Dropping it short outside off, George Dockrell sees Ruben Trumpelmann rock back and somehow squeeze it away for a streaky boundary.
35.5: Jai Moondra digs it in short at Jack Brassell, sailing high over the batter to signal an extra wide for height.
35.5: Jai Moondra pitches it up on off stump, allowing Jack Brassell to get behind the line and ease it neatly to mid-off.
35.6: Jai Moondra offers room just short of a length, and Jack Brassell punches it out to deep backward point to keep the strike.
36.1: Curtis Campher attacks the stumps with a full delivery, pushed firmly by Jack Brassell straight toward mid-on.
36.2: Curtis Campher drops into a length, and Jack Brassell hangs back to tuck it leg-side for a hurried single.
36.3: Curtis Campher drifts onto middle and leg from a back of a length, guided away by Ruben Trumpelmann toward long leg.
36.4: Curtis Campher lands a beauty that seams sharply inward off the pitch, beating Jack Brassell's inside edge as it whistles over the bail.
36.5: Curtis Campher hits a hard length on off, met solidly by a back-foot punch from Jack Brassell straight to the cover fielder.
36.6: Curtis Campher bowls to Jack Brassell, who drives a full just outside off back to Campher, who half‑stops it toward mid‑off.
37.1: Liam McCarthy bangs it in short on off, pulled comfortably down to long leg by Ruben Trumpelmann for a quick single.
37.2: Liam McCarthy delivers to Jack Brassell, who punches a short‑length ball outside off into deep cover, giving Ruben Trumpelmann back on strike.
37.3: Liam McCarthy serves up a shortish delivery outside off, brutally flat-batted past mid-off by a surging Ruben Trumpelmann all the way to the boundary rope.
37.4: Liam McCarthy drops it short to Ruben Trumpelmann, who stands tall and pulls it ruthlessly through mid-wicket to bring up a brilliant fifty amid applause from the dugout.
37.5: Liam McCarthy delivers the final blow as Ruben Trumpelmann is rooted in his crease, beaten in the channel as the ball clips the top of off to seal Ireland's opening win in the series.

summary.text: Ireland won by 55 runs. IRE made 229-9, Paul Stirling (c) top-scoring with 56 off 71 balls; Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton took 4 for 36. NAM made 174-10, Ruben Trumpelmann top-scoring with 50 off 43 balls; Gavin Hoey took 3 for 29.
